## Python results {#results}

::: {#finding}
Python computes this figure from the accompanying CSV.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-values
#| echo: false
#| dev: svg
import csv
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

svg_epoch = os.environ.setdefault("SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH", "0")
plt.rcParams["svg.hashsalt"] = "qbento-python-computation"

with open("data.csv", newline="") as data:
    values = [float(row["value"]) for row in csv.DictReader(data)]

lines = plt.plot(values, marker="o")
title = plt.title("Values from data.csv")
plt.show()
```

## Computed total {#summary}

```{python}
#| label: python-total
#| echo: true
print("Computed sum:", sum(values))
```
